user_check.note: All user lines were short, casual, and non-technical; replies answered at most two questions, disclosed only requested facts, and deferred choices not specified in the bank.

withheld.fact: Use the home screen picture first, then the workout screen picture.
The ad should be 10 seconds long.
Keep the look clean and energetic.
The assistant can choose the other wording and design details.
Any wording should be in English.

judge.note: The assistant used plain questions and accepted the duration and audio choices, but unnecessarily re-asked where to post after being told to choose, silently switched from vertical to landscape, omitted actual screenshot references from the call, and specified a finish without the requested FitTrack title.
